ValidationRule.description: Checks payment directly since jumping straight to Closed Won skips the Take the Keys payment checkpoint entirely. LFRDN-341 FR1 added registration (Traffic Form) and signed delivery note (Customer Sign-Off) via AF_Handover__c.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), OR( NOT(AF_HandoverComplete__c), NOT(AF_DeliveryConfirmation__c), ISBLANK(AF_InvoiceSummary__c), AF_InvoiceBalance__c <> 0, ISBLANK(AF_Handover__c), NOT(AF_Handover__r.AF_TrafficFormUploaded__c), ISPICKVAL(AF_Handover__r.AF_CustomerSignOff__c, "Pending") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Closed Won requires Handover Complete, Delivery Confirmation, full payment (Invoice Balance = 0), the Traffic Form (registration) uploaded, and Customer Sign-Off (signed delivery note) on the linked Handover.
